O.outcome_detail: comprehension and synthesis of debate content in assigned essays

cells.quote: Some students made use of other features within the Zoom debate to create a quasi-synchronous experience toward better cognitive engagement.
cells.note: The study reports a qualitative finding rather than a quantified effect; the comparison with participants who did not use these features is implicit.

D.treatment: interactive video zone 0 plus instructor-led zone 1

O.outcome_detail: full CPR checklist competence after zone 1 training

cells.quote: After zone 1 training, 100% (28/28) of the experimental group achieved competence vs 84% (16/19) of the control group (P=.06, Fisher exact test).
cells.note: The study states that all participants had no prior CPR training; the intervention combined a self-directed interactive-video session with a 4-hour instructor-led seminar, whereas the comparison received the seminar only.

result.effect: No statistical test result reported in the abstract
